plants.name: Philodendron 'Pink Princess'
plants.tip: The pink only holds in bright light. Cut back to a variegated node if it reverts.

plants.name: Philodendron 'White Knight'
plants.tip: The white areas scorch in strong sun and revert in shade. Bright, indirect light keeps the pattern stable.

plants.name: Philodendron 'White Wizard'
plants.tip: The white sections need bright, indirect light to stay white, and scorch in direct sun.

plants.name: Philodendron 'White Princess'
plants.tip: Variegation is unstable. Cut back any stem that reverts to plain green.

plants.name: Philodendron 'Rio'
plants.tip: A slow trailing form. Let the top third of the soil dry before watering again.

plants.name: Philodendron 'Silver Stripe'
plants.tip: The silver striping holds best in bright, indirect light and fades in shade.

plants.name: Philodendron 'Snow Drift'
plants.tip: Leaves stay creamier in bright light; too little and the variegation goes plain green.

plants.name: Philodendron 'Lemon Lime'
plants.tip: Colour fades to plain green in dim light. Keep it bright, but out of hot sun.

plants.name: Philodendron 'Golden Crocodile'
plants.tip: The gold speckling needs bright light; in shade it fades back to green.

plants.name: Philodendron 'Malay Gold'
plants.tip: The gold contrast needs bright, indirect light and reverts quickly in shade.

plants.name: Philodendron 'Rojo Congo'
plants.tip: New leaves open deep red before fading to green. Wipe the big leaves to keep them glossy.

plants.name: Philodendron 'McColley's Finale'
plants.tip: The coral on new growth is the show. Bright, indirect light keeps it coming.
plants.colour: Coral-orange new leaves maturing to green

plants.name: Philodendron 'Prince of Orange'
plants.tip: New leaves open bright orange then fade; the strongest colour needs the brightest light.

plants.name: Philodendron 'Autumn'
plants.tip: Colour is richest in bright, indirect light. Water when the top few centimetres are dry.

plants.name: Philodendron 'Imperial Red'
plants.tip: The red is strongest on new growth in bright, indirect light.
plants.colour: Deep red young leaves over dark green

plants.name: Philodendron 'Imperial Green'
plants.tip: Slow and sturdy. Brush dust off the big leaves regularly so they can photosynthesise.

plants.name: Philodendron 'Black Cardinal'
plants.tip: The dark pigment fades in dim light. Bright, indirect light keeps the leaves almost black.

plants.name: Philodendron 'Black Knight'
plants.tip: Full, near-black colour needs the brightest spot you have.
plants.colour: Almost black leaves with red stems

plants.name: Philodendron 'Red Empress'
plants.tip: New growth is deep red. Keep it in bright, indirect light to hold the colour.

plants.name: Philodendron 'Painted Lady'
plants.tip: The blotching needs bright light, and the red stems respond to cooler nights.

plants.name: Philodendron 'Moonlight'
plants.tip: The lime colour is brightest in bright, indirect light; dim rooms turn it dull green.

plants.name: Philodendron 'Golden Dragon'
plants.tip: The dragon-scale speckle needs strong, indirect light to stay bright.

plants.name: Philodendron 'Ring of Fire'
plants.tip: Each new leaf unfurls a different mix of cream, orange and maroon; keep it in bright light or the colour washes out.
plants.colour: Lobed leaves in cream, orange and maroon

plants.name: Philodendron 'Jungle Boogie'
plants.tip: The leaves stay deeply lobed in bright light. Water as the top of the soil dries.

plants.name: Philodendron 'Narrow Escape'
plants.tip: Young leaves are very narrow; they widen as the plant matures. Keep it bright.

plants.name: Philodendron 'Florida Ghost'
plants.tip: New leaves open white and colour up; the brightest white needs strong, indirect light.

plants.name: Philodendron 'Florida Green'
plants.tip: A vigorous climber. Give it a moss pole and it rewards with bigger, more divided leaves.

plants.name: Philodendron 'Splendid'
plants.tip: A velvet hybrid that wants humidity. Keep the leaf surfaces free of standing water.

plants.name: Philodendron gloriosum
plants.tip: A ground crawler — plant it flat in a wide pot, not up a pole. The white veins prefer a humid corner.

plants.name: Philodendron melanochrysum
plants.tip: A climbing velvet. It wants humidity and a moss pole to reach full, large-leaf form.
plants.colour: Velvet dark green with gold veins

plants.name: Philodendron verrucosum
plants.tip: Fussy about humidity; a misted, humid corner beats a dry living room.

plants.name: Philodendron sodiroi
plants.tip: The silver speckle holds in good, indirect light and humidity.

plants.name: Philodendron mayoi
plants.tip: A self-heading plant with hand-like leaves. Water when the top of the soil dries.

plants.name: Philodendron brandtianum
plants.tip: A trailing climber. The silver marbling fades without bright, indirect light.

plants.name: Philodendron plowmanii
plants.tip: A crawler with a frilled leaf base; keep it wide and low in a humid spot.

plants.name: Philodendron pastazanum
plants.tip: Big leaves mean big thirst — keep the soil lightly moist and the air humid.

plants.name: Philodendron mamei
plants.tip: The silver is etched on the leaf surface; it likes humidity and bright, indirect light.

plants.name: Philodendron 'Burle Marx'
plants.tip: Narrow, fanning leaves on short stems. Water as the top of the soil dries.

plants.name: Philodendron 'Red Emerald'
plants.tip: A climber named for its red stems and petioles; give it something to scale.

plants.name: Philodendron giganteum
plants.tip: One of the largest philodendrons; give it room and let the top of the soil dry before watering.
plants.colour: Huge corrugated green with red-edged new growth
